title: Streamed signed BSGS with batched Jacobian normalization

claims.statement: For the unrestricted uniform full-production secp256k1 target Q=[x]P, the deterministic classical cold attack in proof.md succeeds with probability at least1/2 using at most2^(553/4) target-group-operation equivalents under protected C=1000. Peak storage below2^146 bytes; preprocessing included in total and bounded by2^(553/4); zero nonuniform advice bytes(log convention0). No heuristic assumptions. Analytic construction, not a practical break or executed production attack.

experiments.purpose: Bounded stream sorting/intersection, exact coverage, Jacobian and zero-safe batch normalization, negative controls and analytic ledger; no production timing inference.
